name: Expert_ABE_BE_RSI
summary: This EA uses an RSI indicator smoothed by a Moving Average (CBE_BE_RSI signal) to generate buy/sell signals within the MQL5 Standard Library Expert framework. It employs fixed lot sizing for money management and no trailing stop, relying on the signal thresholds for entry and exit decisions.
summary_zh: 该EA使用经移动平均线平滑处理的RSI指标（CBE_BE_RSI信号）在MQL5标准库Expert框架内生成买卖信号。它采用固定手数的资金管理方式，不使用移动止损，依靠信号阈值来决定入场和出场。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于RSI（相对强弱指数）指标及其移动平均线的组合，属于动量类策略。入场条件由CBE_BE_RSI信号过滤器决定，当RSI与其MA的交叉或偏离达到开仓阈值（默认40）时开仓，达到平仓阈值（默认20）时平仓。出场条件除信号阈值外，还支持止损和止盈设置，但默认值均为0即未启用。仓位管理采用固定手数方式（默认0.1手），不根据账户资金动态调整。资金管理使用CMoneyFixedLot类，仅按固定百分比（默认10%）和固定手数进行配置。策略未使用移动止损（CTrailingNone），这意味着持仓后完全依赖信号反转来平仓，缺乏动态保护机制。挂单有效期设为4根K线，超时后自动取消未成交挂单。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy is based on a combination of the RSI (Relative Strength Index) indicator smoothed by a Moving Average, classifying it as a momentum-type strategy. Entry conditions are determined by the CBE_BE_RSI signal filter, opening positions when the RSI/MA crossover or deviation reaches the open threshold (default 40) and closing when reaching the close threshold (default 20). Exit conditions, besides signal thresholds, also support stop loss and take profit settings, but both default to 0, meaning they are effectively disabled. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach (default 0.1 lots) without dynamic adjustment based on account equity. Money management employs the CMoneyFixedLot class, configured only with a fixed percentage (default 10%) and fixed lot size. The strategy does not use trailing stops (CTrailingNone), meaning it relies entirely on signal reversal for position closure after entry, lacking dynamic protection mechanisms. Pending orders expire after 4 bars, automatically canceling unfilled orders beyond that timeframe.

pros: 基于标准库Expert框架构建，代码结构规范清晰，易于维护和扩展
RSI加MA平滑设计能有效减少虚假信号，提高信号质量
挂单有效期限制（4根K线）避免了过时挂单的意外成交
信号开仓阈值（40）高于平仓阈值（20），形成非对称进出逻辑，有助于捕捉趋势
pros_en: Built on the MQL5 Standard Library Expert framework with clean, well-structured code that is easy to maintain and extend
RSI smoothed by MA effectively reduces false signals and improves signal quality
Pending order expiration (4 bars) prevents stale orders from being unexpectedly filled
Asymmetric entry/exit thresholds (open=40, close=20) help capture trending moves by requiring stronger signals for entry than exit
cons: 止损和止盈默认值均为0，实际交易中存在极大风险，持仓可能无限亏损
不使用移动止损，盈利头寸缺乏保护，可能出现大幅回撤后才平仓
固定手数资金管理过于简单，未考虑账户净值变化和波动率调整
策略逻辑完全依赖单一信号过滤器，缺乏多维度确认和过滤机制
cons_en: Stop loss and take profit both default to 0, posing extreme risk as positions can suffer unlimited losses in live trading
No trailing stop means profitable positions lack protection, potentially giving back significant gains before the signal reverses
Fixed lot money management is overly simplistic, ignoring account equity changes and volatility-based position sizing
Strategy logic relies entirely on a single signal filter without multi-dimensional confirmation or filtering mechanisms
improvements: 添加默认止损和止盈参数，并设置合理的非零默认值以保护持仓
引入移动止损（如CTrailingFixed或CTrailingMA）来锁定盈利并动态保护头寸
增加多时间框架确认机制，例如在更高时间框架上验证趋势方向后再入场
改进资金管理为动态手数计算（如基于ATR或账户余额百分比），提高风险适应性
improvements_en: Add default stop loss and take profit parameters with reasonable non-zero defaults to protect positions
Implement trailing stops (e.g., CTrailingFixed or CTrailingMA) to lock in profits and dynamically protect positions
Add multi-timeframe confirmation, such as verifying the trend direction on a higher timeframe before entering
Upgrade money management to dynamic lot calculation (e.g., ATR-based or account equity percentage) for better risk adaptability

risk_points: 止损和止盈默认为0，实盘运行可能导致单笔交易无限亏损
无移动止损保护，盈利头寸可能大幅回撤至亏损
单一信号过滤器缺乏冗余验证，在震荡市中可能频繁假突破产生亏损交易
risk_points_en: Stop loss and take profit defaulting to 0 can lead to unlimited per-trade losses in live trading
No trailing stop protection means winning positions can retrace significantly into loss territory
Single signal filter lacks redundant validation, potentially generating frequent false breakout losses in ranging markets
